summary: One coherent behavior: give the surface and coast bands their section 14.3 visual identity (palette, visibility, particles, attenuation, silhouettes, debris, currents) expressed via the existing render pipeline and the shared band-data seam, with the section 15 flashlight behavior and the section 59 cozy surface baseline as part of dressing that same surface band rather than separate shippable work. Two named changed responsibilities (rendering/materials, world content data), within the leaf limit. Evidence is focused: per-band 1080p browser inspection with screenshots, a Node test asserting at least two distinguishing identity factors, and green suite/build; no open-ended defect fixing. Parent criteria AC-art-palettes and AC-art-contrast are carried verbatim; the cross-band part of AC-art-palettes is explicitly deferred to final proof owner WI-06d, and AC-art-contrast names this item as final proof owner. Boundary with WI-06d (critical-path dressing here vs debug geometry elsewhere) is stated. Handoff (ST-06/plan.md, request sections 1.1/14/15/59, band data seam in understanding.md, src/render/ plus world data) lets a fresh implementer proceed without reconstructing the project.
